subject: uploading files to locally running app

messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: uploading files to locally running app
parts:
In case it might be useful for others ... It took me some time to get this working but the following works in my app. 

When the app starts and when the upload box gets checked (or unchecked) the user is asked to select a file. I understand an action button will be added to the main shiny package at some point, until then this works ok.

In ui.R

    checkboxInput("upload", "Load data by (un)checking the box", value = FALSE),

In server.R

  output$dataloaded <- reactiveUI(function() {

    # adding 'input$loaded' makes sure this function gets called when input$upload changes (on-to-off or off-to-on)
    input$upload
    filename <- file.choose()
    newdata <- load(filename, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    data_sets <<- unique(c(newdata,data_sets))
  
    selectInput(inputId = "dataset", label = "Data sets", choices = data_sets, selected = data_sets[1], multiple = FALSE)
  })

messages.subject: Re: uploading files to locally running app
parts:
Yann Richet suggested using fileInput. It got it to work. Code below.

For an example see:

shiny::runGist('4385800')

server.R

loaddata <- function(state) {
  inFile <- state$upload
  if (is.null(inFile))
    return(NULL)

  filename <- inFile$name
  ext <- file_ext(filename)
  file <- newdata <- sub(paste(".",ext,sep = ""),"",filename)
  ext <- tolower(ext)
  if(ext == 'rda' || ext == 'rdata') {
    newdata <- load(inFile$datapath, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  # by putting this here we get the name of the object inside the R data file
  data_sets <<- unique(c(newdata,data_sets))

  if(ext == 'sav') {
    assign(file, read.spss(inFile$datapath), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if(ext == 'dta') {
    assign(file, read.dta(inFile$datapath), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  } else if(ext == 'csv') {
    assign(file, read.csv(inFile$datapath, header = TRUE), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}

  output$dataloaded <- reactiveUI(function() {
    # adding 'input$loaded' means the function gets called when input$upload changes
    # by putting it in this function the list of data also gets updated
    input$upload
    loaddata(as.list(input))

    # Drop-down selection of data set

selectInput(inputId = "dataset", label = "Data sets", choices = data_sets, selected = data_sets[1], multiple = FALSE)
  })

ui.R

     fileInput("upload", "Load data (Rdata, CSV, Spss, or Stata format)")
